definitions.scope: Already-exposed original inputs: deterministic SI display and reviewer QC. No new validation, fitting, sample exclusion, score replacement, measurement uncertainty model, geographical weighting or causal inference.
definitions.flow_semantics: One terminal status is assigned to each sample-ID union record by the original if/elif order. Terminal counts partition records, but possible failure causes are not mutually exclusive. Later causes were not evaluated after an earlier assignment. This exporter copies statuses, not their causes.
definitions.weight_semantics: For the six fixed primary layer means only, let d_k=e_model,k^2-e_reference,k^2. For arbitrary w_k>=0 with sum(w_k)=1, the weighted MSE difference is sum(w_k*d_k); weighted RMSE has the same ordering because square root is increasing. The exporter does not choose or optimize weights or generate a new weighted score. This is about stored point errors, not the RSD scenarios, an uncertainty box, area-weighted geography, new intra-layer weights or bottle-level errors.
definitions.domain_semantics: Labels describe the rectangle formed by extrema of the original six training alpha means and original six observed-pH means, with endpoints included. These are six global calibration-layer means, not the full feature range of the 1,755 source-compilation records or of all source bottles. They do not estimate a joint calibrated validity region, create new subset scores or establish prospective suitability; observed target pH is required to assign the second axis. Rows are layer means, not independent bottles.
definitions.exported_domain_selection: Exactly variant=primary, six rows per leg
